title: John Cage — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of John Cage's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. pieces.title: The coins decide
pieces.caption: Sixteen sounds. For each, three coins were thrown six times, as for the I Ching, and the six lines chose the pitch, the length, the loudness, and whether the string is prepared. Two of the sixteen came up silence. *What is real and what is a choice:* Thrown once from the computer's random source and kept as thrown. The mapping from lines to sounds is mine; the result is not. *Leaking in:* Brian Eno, by the link labelled 'coins-and-tape-loops'.
